summary: TAT Technologies Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K containing unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, along with an operating and financial review. The filing incorporates these exhibits by reference into existing Form F-3 and S-8 registration statements. This is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, providing financial results and segment data. No special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or capital return, is disclosed. The event is purely an earnings-related current report with no deal terms or transaction mechanics to analyze.
